qa_pairs.question: How do I install the CephFS client on a Red Hat Enterprise Linux family VM (e.g., RHEL, CentOS, Fedora, Rocky, Alma)?
qa_pairs.answer: To install the CephFS client on a Red Hat Enterprise Linux family VM, first add the Ceph software repository by creating `/etc/yum.repos.d/ceph.repo` with the appropriate content for your EL version (e.g., `el9` or `el10`), pointing to `http://download.ceph.com/rpm-tentacle/` for the latest stable release (as of June 2026, 'tentacle'). Next, install the Extra Packages for Enterprise Linux (EPEL) repository using `sudo dnf install epel-release`. If you're running EL10, temporarily disable the default cryptographic policy with `sudo update-crypto-policies --set LEGACY`. Then, import the Ceph project's public key using `sudo rpm --import 'https://download.ceph.com/keys/release.asc'`. Finally, install the client packages with `sudo dnf install -y libcephfs2 python3-cephfs ceph-common python3-ceph-argparse`. Remember to restore the default cryptographic policy on EL10 systems with `sudo update-crypto-policies --set DEFAULT` afterward.

qa_pairs.question: What is the procedure for installing the CephFS client on a Debian-based VM (e.g., Debian, Ubuntu, Mint)?
qa_pairs.answer: To install the CephFS client on a Debian-based VM, first determine your distribution's codename using `lsb_release -sc`. Then, add the Ceph repository using `sudo apt-add-repository 'deb https://download.ceph.com/debian-tentacle/ {codename} main'`. If this command gives an error, revert it with `sudo add-apt-repository -r 'deb https://download.ceph.com/debian-tentacle/ {codename} main'`. After adding the repository, install the necessary CephFS client packages by running `sudo apt-get install -y libcephfs2 python3-cephfs ceph-common python3-ceph-argparse`.
